review_status: Source-checked by AI; pending local agronomist and native Urdu review

rules.applicability: Global Zea mays screening reference; not a locally validated planting recommendation. Compare every available topsoil depth separately. Bounds crossing the reference interval require field testing.
Kenyan guidance favours well-drained soils. Farmer-reported standing water prompts drainage review, without engineering prescriptions.
Check moisture through the soil profile before sowing; cached regional rainfall cannot establish field moisture.

non_agronomic_policy.soil_uncertainty: Flag missing quantiles or a 90% interval crossing either pH reference boundary. No invented width threshold.
non_agronomic_policy.forecast: Require valid interval, issue time <= now, issue age <=48 hours, verified units and source. 48h is a conservative application freshness policy, not a crop threshold.
non_agronomic_policy.other_soil_properties: Stored for context only. No thresholds or fertilizer prescriptions.
